name: ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस (सारथी)
description: Application for learner's licence, driving licence, and renewals through the Parivahan Sarathi portal.
benefits: Legal authorisation to drive; valid identity/address proof.
steps: Visit Sarathi Parivahan and select your state.
Apply for Learner's Licence and pay fees.
After the mandatory period, apply for the driving licence.
Book and pass the driving test at the RTO.
Receive the DL by post / download.
